bearerAuth.description: Scoped Hub bearer token; never put it in the URL.

info.description: One current unpublished API. Scopes are exact grants. Explicit server-enabled unauthenticated loopback is a development override; administrative import also requires allow-state-restore and remains empty-bootstrap-only. This document covers Hub HTTP, not Payment Gateway or chain readiness. Structural schemas do not replace domain validation. No signer state is restored through these endpoints.
